From 57ad33a307bf85cafda3a77c03a555c9f9ee4139 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Dec 2017 09:52:31 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amdgpu: only check mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER on
 tonga/fiji

We only support SR-IOV on tonga/fiji.  Don't check this register
on other VI parts.

Fixes: 048765ad5af7c89 (amdgpu: fix asic initialization for virtualized environments (v2))
Reviewed-by: Xiangliang Yu <Xiangliang.Yu@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/vi.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/vi.c
index d9bb26322850..c59b37365e4d 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/vi.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/vi.c
@@ -449,14 +449,19 @@ static bool vi_read_bios_from_rom(struct amdgpu_device *adev,
 
 static void vi_detect_hw_virtualization(struct amdgpu_device *adev)
 {
-	uint32_t reg = RREG32(mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER);
-	/* bit0: 0 means pf and 1 means vf */
-	/* bit31: 0 means disable IOV and 1 means enable */
-	if (reg & 1)
-		adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_IS_VF;
-
-	if (reg & 0x80000000)
-		adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_ENABLE_IOV;
+	uint32_t reg = 0;
+
+	if (adev->asic_type == CHIP_TONGA ||
+	    adev->asic_type == CHIP_FIJI) {
+	       reg = RREG32(mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER);
+	       /* bit0: 0 means pf and 1 means vf */
+	       /* bit31: 0 means disable IOV and 1 means enable */
+	       if (reg & 1)
+		       adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_IS_VF;
+
+	       if (reg & 0x80000000)
+		       adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_ENABLE_IOV;
+	}
 
 	if (reg == 0) {
 		if (is_virtual_machine()) /* passthrough mode exclus sr-iov mode */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/vi.c`**
- The function `vi_detect_hw_virtualization` was modified to conditionally check the `mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER` register only for specific ASIC types: `CHIP_TONGA` and `CHIP_FIJI`.
- The original code read the register unconditionally, which could lead to incorrect behavior on other ASIC types. The new code initializes the `reg` variable to `0` and only reads the register if the ASIC type matches the specified conditions.
- The logic that checks the bits of the register to set virtualization capabilities (`AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_IS_VF` and `AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_ENABLE_IOV`) is now encapsulated within the conditional check.

### Relationships
- The modification in `vi.c` directly addresses a bug related to the initialization of the AMD GPU in virtualized environments by ensuring that the register check is only performed for the supported ASIC types (Tonga and Fiji). This change prevents potential misconfiguration or erroneous capability flags from being set for unsupported ASIC types, thereby improving the stability and correctness of the driver in virtualized scenarios. The patch is a refinement of the previous fix referenced in the commit message, ensuring that the driver behaves correctly across different hardware configurations.

Here is the commit message:
drm/amdgpu: only check mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER on
 tonga/fiji

We only support SR-IOV on tonga/fiji.  Don't check this register
on other VI parts.

Fixes: 048765ad5af7c89 (amdgpu: fix asic initialization for virtualized environments (v2))
Reviewed-by: Xiangliang Yu <Xiangliang.Yu@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the unconditional reading of the `mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER` register in the `vi_detect_hw_virtualization` function, which could lead to incorrect virtualization capability flags being set for AMD GPUs that do not support SR-IOV (Single Root I/O Virtualization). This could result in improper initialization of the GPU in virtualized environments, particularly for ASIC types other than Tonga and Fiji.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void vi_detect_hw_virtualization(struct amdgpu_device *adev)
 {
-	uint32_t reg = RREG32(mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER);
-	/* bit0: 0 means pf and 1 means vf */
-	/* bit31: 0 means disable IOV and 1 means enable */
-	if (reg & 1)
-		adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_IS_VF;
-
-	if (reg & 0x80000000)
-		adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_ENABLE_IOV;
+	uint32_t reg = 0;
+
+	if (adev->asic_type == CHIP_TONGA ||
+	    adev->asic_type == CHIP_FIJI) {
+	       reg = RREG32(mmBIF_IOV_FUNC_IDENTIFIER);
+	       /* bit0: 0 means pf and 1 means vf */
+	       /* bit31: 0 means disable IOV and 1 means enable */
+	       if (reg & 1)
+		       adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_IS_VF;
+
+	       if (reg & 0x80000000)
+		       adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_SRIOV_CAPS_ENABLE_IOV;
+	}
 
 	if (reg == 0) {
 		if (is_virtual_machine()) /* passthrough mode exclus sr-iov mode */
 			adev->virt.caps |= AMDGPU_PASSTHROUGH_MODE;
 	}
 }
